# Ban Types
You may submit a ban appeal in the #ban-appeal forum on the official AFTERLIGHT Discord server.
## Role Ban A ban that prevents your joining a round as a specific role or job. These are often used in response to problematic behavior in particular departments or address gross inexperience in important roles such as heads of staff. These bans do not mechanically prevent you from switching to the role during a round or acting as that role, but doing so is considered ban evasion and will be punished as such. This is different from an in-character job suspension. Also referred to as a "job ban".
## Game Ban A ban that prevents you from connecting to any AFTERLIGHT Space Station server. Also referred to as a "server ban".
